visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with blonde-dyed hair and a beard, wearing a white zip-up hoodie, sits at a dark table in a gym office. He holds a black clipboard and a white pen, looking toward another person off-camera with a persuasive expression. (2) The camera cuts to a medium two-shot showing a second man with a large black afro and extensive tattoos on his chest and arms, wearing a black tank top. He gestures skeptically while looking at the man in the hoodie. (3) The man in the hoodie leans forward aggressively, pointing at the clipboard with his pen while speaking. Behind him, a bright orange neon sign in the shape of an 'X' glows on the wall, illuminating the dark equipment in the background. (4) The scene shifts through rapid cuts and zooms, focusing on the man with the afro who appears frustrated, rubbing his face and looking down. The lighting is high-contrast, highlighting the textures of their skin and clothing. (5) In a dramatic and comedic close-up, the man in the hoodie uses his fingers to pull his upper and lower eyelids wide open, staring intensely at the man with the afro. (6) The final sequence shows both men back in a two-shot, with the man with the afro looking defeated and the man in the hoodie maintaining his intense, focused stare while holding the pen near his face.
